title: Past Tenses
description: The simple past (completed actions, indicators of the past, regular and irregular verbs, questions and negatives with did), the present perfect (have/has + past participle for experience, change and news; just, already, recently, lately; never with a finished time), and the past progressive (was/were + verb + ing for an action in progress)
